verificationSent.description: Open the link in your mailbox to verify this address.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear across the application.

email.title: Email address
email.description: The address you sign in with and where account email is sent.
email.unverifiedHint: Changing the password or the authenticator needs a verified address. Entered the wrong email when signing up?

awaiting_new.next: Open the confirmation link sent to the new address. Confirming it completes the change and signs out every session; sign in afterwards with the new address.

changeForm.hint: A confirmation link is sent here first. After confirming it, you choose the new address in this section, and the new mailbox confirms as well.
changeForm.replacingHint: The request currently in progress is cancelled.

confirm.title: Change your sign-in email?
confirm.replacing: The current request is cancelled and its links stop working.
confirm.description: {prefix}A confirmation link is sent to {email}. After confirming it you will choose the new address here, and the new mailbox confirms it as well. Nothing changes until then; the request expires after 24 hours.

correctionForm.label: Correct email address
correctionForm.hint: Use this when {email} is wrong or unreachable. A confirmation link is sent to the corrected address only; nothing is sent to the current one. Confirming it completes the change and signs out every session.

newEmailForm.label: Enter new email address
newEmailForm.hint: A confirmation link is sent to this address. Once chosen it cannot be edited; cancel and start again to pick another.

password.title: Password
password.description: Used together with your email address to sign in.
password.label: Password
password.unverifiedHint: Verify your email address to change the password here. A forgotten password can always be reset from the sign-in page.

form.label: Change password
form.hint: Between 8 and 128 characters; a password manager is welcome.

authenticator.title: Authenticator
authenticator.description: A code from an authenticator app at sign-in and for sensitive changes.
authenticator.requiredTooltip: Your role requires an authenticator; it can be replaced but not disabled.
authenticator.unverifiedHint: Verify your email address to manage the authenticator.

confirm.title: Disable your authenticator?

replace.code: Scan and confirm the new one

codeForm.hintEnroll: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows for the app.

codeForm.qrTitle: Scan to set up your authenticator
codeForm.manualKey: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: One-time codes that replace your authenticator when it is unavailable.

unavailable.title: New codes were generated but could not be shown
unavailable.description: Your previous codes no longer work. Generate again to get a set you can save.

generated.title: New recovery codes generated
generated.description: Your previous codes no longer work.

confirm.title: Generate new recovery codes?
confirm.description: Your previous recovery codes immediately stop working. The new set is shown once; save it before closing.

result.saved: I have saved these codes in a safe place.
